context_note: These results concern my historical tissue and plasma; my current lymph node has no published molecular profile. Different specimens and assays limit comparisons; VAF is the fraction of sequenced alleles, not tumour fraction.

variant_review_scope: Released public clinical reports only; exact Caris/Tempus/Guardant classification and VAF visually checked in rasterized PDFs. Selected research read IDs are linked without clinical reclassification.
variant_count_note: Each alteration appears once. SOX9 and SMARCA4 are grouped by the Caris classification, with the differing Tempus VUS calls shown alongside; I have not resolved that disagreement.
research_read_note: Read counts are selected-locus research audits from M-SOURCE-006. Caller-specific reads and distinct-read-pair-name proxies are different units. biomarker_rows.summary: MLH1, MSH2, MSH6 and PMS2 nuclear expression retained in March 2024 rectal biopsies.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: The published pathology supports historical proficient mismatch repair; it is not a new assay of current metastatic disease.

biomarker_rows.summary: Caris March 2024 biopsy: MSS, TMB 5 mutations/Mb. Tempus October 2024 resection: MSS, TMB 4.2 mutations/Mb. BostonGene: TMB 0.42 mutations/Mb in residual rectal tumour after chemoradiation (October 2024; 15% tumour content); MSI and copy number were not reported.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: BostonGene’s low tumour content limits detection sensitivity; its TMB estimate and negative mutation findings need caution. Keep assay-specific values separate: the lower estimate does not establish a change over time. Historical MSS/low TMB do not provide an MSI-high/TMB-high treatment biomarker.

biomarker_rows.biomarker: KRAS / NRAS / BRAF and kinase biomarkers
biomarker_rows.summary: Caris reported KRAS, NRAS and BRAF mutations not detected; ERBB2/HER2 and EGFR amplification and NTRK1/2/3, BRAF and RET fusions not detected. Tempus reported no pathogenic KRAS/NRAS/BRAF variant or copy-number change, and no reportable RNA rearrangement or altered splicing.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: Historical RAS/BRAF wild-type findings support the rationale for EGFR-directed treatment. They do not exclude acquired resistance after prior panitumumab; current resistance is unassessed.

biomarker_rows.summary: Predicted HLA-A A*02:01/A*02:01; HLA-B B*07:02/B*44:02; HLA-C C*03:04/C*05:01. Caris reported HLA-A loss of heterozygosity not detected. BostonGene’s low MHC-I bulk-RNA signature came from residual rectal tissue after chemoradiation, with 15% tumour content.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: Relevant to vaccine and HLA-restricted cell-therapy research. Predicted HLA needs clinical confirmation; full clinical class-II typing is absent. Negative HLA-A LOH and a low-purity bulk-RNA signature establish neither intact presentation nor tumour-cell MHC-I loss at current tumour sites.

biomarker_rows.summary: Blood collected 18 December 2025: tumour fraction <0.05%; biomarker-negative confidence <90%; no reportable somatic alteration with an associated therapy. Blood TMB not evaluable; MSI-high not detected. TRAF2 p.T113I at 1.7% cfDNA classified VUS.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: Essentially undetectable tumour DNA makes negative plasma findings uninformative about absence of disease or current RAS/RAF genotype. TRAF2’s tumour origin is unconfirmed; its 1.7% cfDNA allele fraction is separate from the <0.05% tumour-fraction estimate.

biomarker_rows.summary: Blood collected 27 January 2026: estimated tumour fraction 0.0%; no pathogenic tumour-derived somatic variant or therapy-associated biomarker detected. Blood TMB and MSI indeterminate.
biomarker_rows.therapy_connection: Do not call this plasma assay MSS or low TMB. A negative result with 0.0% reported tumour fraction cannot rule out disease or current resistance.

expression_note: My archived liver resection contained residual disease after treatment. RNA percentages are calculated within cells classified as tumour, not all cells or surface protein. Target IHC used liver block C4 with about 5% viable tumour; the exact link to the single-cell aliquot remains unresolved. These historical results do not establish expression in my current metastases.
specimen_note: The expression and target-IHC evidence comes from liver metastasis resected 22 October 2024, not the recent lymph node. Valius single-cell profiling used FFPE 10x Flex v2: 92,897 cells, including 1,018 classified as tumour; exact single-cell aliquot-to-block linkage remains unresolved. The IHC reports identify liver block C4, about 5% viable tumour in a predominantly acellular mucinous lesion, adequate for IHC. 28 April 2026 is reaccession, not tissue collection. Detectable RNA percentages are not measurements of surface protein or evidence of amplification.
pathology: My rectal and liver resections confirmed moderately differentiated colorectal adenocarcinoma with treatment-associated mucinous features. Rectal stage: ypT3N1aM1a; 1/12 nodes positive, numerous tumour deposits, venous and perineural invasion. Margins were negative (closest 2 mm); treatment response was partial (score 2). Later review of 1/3 evaluable nodes does not replace the original 1/12 count.
bostongene_immunecontext: BostonGene analysed residual rectal tumour after chemoradiation, from block B4 collected 22 October 2024 (report 30 September 2026; estimated tumour content 15%). Low tumour content limits detection sensitivity; MSI and copy number were not reported. Bulk-RNA signatures were fibrotic, immune non-inflamed, low MHC-I and medium PD-L1. They describe a mixture of tumour, stromal and immune cells in previously treated tissue, not tumour-cell MHC-I loss, absent antigen presentation, a PD-L1 IHC score or the immune state of my current metastases.
provenance_limits: The recent clavicular/supraclavicular node has no published collection date, histology, tumour fraction or current molecular results.

The merged Valius/Kandinsky gene-explorer CSV mixes BostonGene rectal bulk and Valius liver single-cell evidence. Its bulk expression columns are log2(TPM+1); a complete column-to-input manifest remains needed.
Per-cell matrices and native mutant-transcript/TCR evidence are not supplied by the liver aggregate expression summaries.

The additional Caris expression CSV is linked to the Assure blood case collected 27 January 2026. Its cellular/buffy-coat RNA fraction is inferred; do not treat it as rectal-tumour expression or compare raw TPM directly with tumour-report percentiles.
TrufflePig RNA composition, tumour-purity and hypoxia findings are exploratory model estimates with unverified source specimen and inputs.

vaccine.title: JLF and Invoke vaccine target comparison
vaccine.description: Source-grounded comparison of all 20 JLF precursor designs with corresponding Invoke candidates, plus the five leading Invoke-only candidates. This is a selected research summary, not a clinical or manufacturing release.
vaccine.summary: All 20 JLF targets appear in Invoke’s ranked 250-candidate report. Thirteen class-I windows match; seven differ. Target overlap does not mean identical peptide designs.
vaccine.introduction_first_person: JLF proposed 20 peptide precursors. Invoke ranked 250 candidate targets, including the same targets and additional candidates. These are historical research designs; RNA support and prediction scores do not establish antigen presentation, immune recognition or retention in my current metastases.
limitations: Historical research designs; current metastatic retention is not established.
JLF is undated and supplies precursor designs, proposed HLA restrictions and epitope styling, without a final manufacturing release or administration record.
Invoke was compiled 2026-09-28. Selected primary-biopsy input linkage is supported; the complete input manifest and normal-sample identity remain unresolved.
Invoke AF and TPM values are report maxima across samples, which may differ in specimen and time. TPM measures bulk gene expression rather than mutant-peptide abundance.
Invoke candidate tiers, ranks and CD8/CD4 probabilities are predictions, not measured antigen presentation or immune recognition.
HLA restrictions shown for shared targets belong to JLF. Candidate-specific HLA restrictions are not supplied in the prepared Invoke candidate table.
Shared genes/variants can have different precursor lengths, epitope windows or transcript context. Preserve exact provider sequences.
The listed peptides are research observations, not final vaccine composition or manufacturing instructions.
